description:
In the Legend of Zelda series’ first
Game Boy adventure, Link is
shipwrecked on the mysterious
Koholint Island. To return home, he
must face a nightmarish new enemy
and solve the riddle of the Wind Fish.

This definitive Game Boy Color
version improves on the original Game
Boy release with an exclusive new
dungeon and colour graphics.

Help Link search for the eight
Instruments of the Sirens, collecting
items like the Pegasus Boots and
Hook Shot, traversing challenging
dungeons, and battling deadly
bosses.

The Legend of Zelda: Link’s
Awakening DX is as rich and
engrossing an adventure as any you
will find on the big screen.
